items.question: Who is accountable for handling shared documents and approving access?
items.evidence_request: Named service owner and RACI; approved security policy

items.question: Exactly which categories of synthetic documents would the vendor process?
items.evidence_request: Data flow diagram; classification and allowlist

items.question: How are vendor access scopes issued, reviewed and revoked?
How are machine and human identities authenticated and protected?
items.evidence_request: Configuration summary and access evidence from a sanctioned review

items.question: Which subcontractors or subservices would handle customer content?
items.evidence_request: Current subprocessor registry and change-notice terms

items.question: Where is data processed and stored, including support and backup access?
items.evidence_request: Data location statement and verified processing flow

items.question: How are retention and deletion requests fulfilled and evidenced?
items.evidence_request: Data lifecycle specification and deletion report template

items.question: Which access events are captured and available for independent review?
items.evidence_request: Event schema; audit retention description; sample synthetic trace

items.question: How quickly and by whom are suspected incidents reported and contained?
items.evidence_request: Incident response playbook; escalation and notification contract

items.question: How are availability commitments and restoration objectives demonstrated?
items.evidence_request: Recovery plan; previous exercise reports if eligible to share

items.question: How are incorrectly extracted records identified and corrected?
items.evidence_request: Data validation rules; reconciliation and exception-handling procedure

items.question: What independent security reports or test results support key vendor claims?
items.evidence_request: Relevant audit scope/date; remediations and exceptions register
